description: Fetch an x402 endpoint URL, read the payment requirement it publishes, and say whether an agent can pay it: the network, the asset, the price, the receiving address and whether that address is its own EIP-55 checksum. One request, no payment, and a verdict a buyer can act on before signing anything. Choose this when you have an x402 endpoint URL and need to know, in one call, whether paying it is sound: the live payment requirement, the network, the asset, the price and the receiving address, with a verdict of payable_now, avoid, not_payment_gated or unverifiable. Do not choose this to judge a manifest you already hold (use x402-endpoint-preflight), or to check a URL's syntax only (use x402-endpoint-audit). It cannot prove that a seller delivers what it sells. Example requests: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it. | Is this x402 endpoint safe to pay, and what is the receiving address? | Read this x402 endpoint's payment requirement and tell me whether it is payable.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

endpoint.description: The x402 resource URL to check, such as 'https://swishrjobs.com/v1/services/csv-preflight/authorize'. 'url' is accepted as an alias.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_x402_endpoint_live_check
title: Live x402 endpoint check
